title: quadrant_intensity_allocation ratio and gradient at DFT field scales and SI areas

fixture.plane: z-normal plane, one sample per quadrant at (x, y) = (-1, -1), (1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, 1) um; electric x component A * [a, 1, 1, 1]; other components zero
variants_required_by_specification: nonuniform quadrature areas at DFT scale
whole-source scale invariance of the ratio and of every gradient
fixture.gradcheck_fixture: 16-point plane from tests/test_detector_allocation.py::plane with complex128 fields scaled by 1e-14 and areas of 1e-14 m^2

reference_method: closed form for A * [a, 1, 1, 1] with equal areas and unit total transmission: first quadrant ratio a^2 / (a^2 + 3) and derivative 6 a / (a^2 + 3)^2; float64 torch.autograd.gradcheck at the DFT scale; unscaled formula on unit-scale fields for the ratio and its gradients

observables.name: d_ratio_d_a
observables.definition: autograd derivative of output[0, 0] with respect to a

observables.name: gradient_finiteness
observables.definition: every gradient with respect to fields and transmission is finite at every amplitude scale

observables.name: scale_invariance
observables.definition: ratio and gradients unchanged when every field sample is multiplied by one positive constant

acceptance.gradients: finite at every declared amplitude scale; no NaN and no exception at 1e-16
acceptance.zero_policy: a zero total electric intensity, a zero or negative area, a negative transmission or a nonfinite input raises ValueError before any division; no epsilon is added to a denominator
acceptance.tightening_note: tests/test_detector_allocation.py asserts absolute errors of 1e-6 on the ratio and 1e-5 on the derivative in float32; those are tighter than the declared limits and are not loosened by this case

not_yet_covered: nonuniform areas, several frequencies and complex phases at DFT scale
whole-source scale invariance of every gradient

notes: The fix landed in f3efd34. Recording evidence against this case does not close the not_yet_covered items; they need tests before G1-03 is judged complete against the specification.
